title: 24 video streams monitored 24/7 on one small host
description:
Test your streams before they reach a device. VirtualPyTest monitors a stream directly (HLS, RTSP, a local file or a YouTube stream) with the same 24/7 checks it runs on devices: picture quality, freeze, black screen, sound, subtitles. Here, 24 live HLS streams run on a single host. Pick a few, open one, and its quality metrics are already there.

Sizing: a 300-channel lineup is about 30 hosts, roughly 6-8 k of hardware for 24/7 monitoring.

Open source and free.
